prompt:
A battle background for a side-on JRPG battle scene (the party will stand on the right, monsters on the left; no characters are drawn), in rich high-resolution 2D pixel art. The world is in an endless night: the sun has vanished and people live by lamplight. Setting: the bottom of oblivion, the place under the world where forgotten, endless stories sink. Back (top 42%): an ink-black void with no sky, torn white tears and rips in the darkness like ripped paper edges, countless loose white pages and open books drifting and sinking slowly in the air, fragments of forgotten places floating upside down far away (a broken staircase, a door frame, a piece of a town wall, a chair), all pale, grey and drained of colour, with faint violet edges. Ground (lower 58%): a vast floating floor made of huge dim grey-violet stone slabs like old paper, with faint ruled lines and torn edges, in deep night shadow (dark mid-grey, not white, not bright), drifts of blank pages, broken quills and a few cracked slabs at the sides, the edges of the floor crumbling into the void far away. Light: only a cold faint glow from the drifting pages, ink-black, slate grey and grey-violet, almost monochrome with a faint violet tint; the scene stays dark. Crisp blocky pixel clusters, not a sketch, not ink drawing. The ground plane recedes from the bottom edge up to the horizon line at a low 3/4 angle; the middle of the ground (from 55% to 90% of the height, centre and right) is open, fairly flat and uncluttered: space for the battle. Details (rocks, plants, debris) sit at the sides and far away. 
No lantern, no fire in the middle, no people, no monsters, no text, no UI.
Pixel art: every art pixel is 4x4 image pixels (the image is 960 x 540 art pixels), crisp square pixels, no anti-aliasing, hue-shifted colour ramps (shadows toward violet, lights toward warm yellow), clusters with clear shapes, not a painting.
revised_prompt: Generate a 16:9 side-on JRPG battle background ONLY, no characters/UI/text, 2D retro pixel art. Composition: party would stand on right, enemies left. 960x540 art-pixel composition, crisp square pixel clusters, no antialiasing, no painterly or drawn strokes; if rendered larger, use strict nearest-neighbor 4x4 image-pixel squares per art pixel. Setting: bottom of oblivion beneath a world of endless night, where forgotten stories sink. Top 42%: near ink-black featureless void without sky; sparse torn white rips with ragged paper-like edges through darkness, loose white pages and open books slowly floating and sinking, distant upside-down fragments of forgotten locations (broken staircase, empty doorframe, bit of town wall, chair) small and far away, pale desaturated grey with faint violet rims. Lower 58%: expansive floating ground plane receding from bottom edge to distant horizon at a low 3/4 angle, paved in HUGE old-paper-like dim DARK grey-violet stone slabs with subtle faint ruled lines and torn margins. Deep night shadow, dark mid-grey ground (NOT white, NOT bright). Sparse blank-page drifts, broken quills, cracks near sides and far away; distant edges crumble into black void. Keep center and right of ground between 55% and 90% of image height FLAT, EMPTY, clear battle staging area; position any debris at sides or distant backdrop. Lighting ONLY subtle cold faint glow of pages; overall very dark, almost monochrome ink-black, slate grey, grey-violet, tiniest restrained warm-yellow highlights in hue-shifted ramps, violet shadows. Rich high-resolution detailed environmental pixel art with deliberately shaped crisp blocky clusters and readable depth. No lanterns, no fires, no sun, no sky, no people, no monsters, no text, no interface.
